lead.headline: Poochinski is at 184.64. It’s Friday.
lead.dek: Eight Poochinski starters played Thursday and all eight cashed. deeboliciouskins has 58.06, seven players left and a 2.1% chance. Everybody else still has calls to make, and AB81’s first one is due at noon.
lead.pull: 184.64 is already more than any other R.A.T.S. team projects to finish the week with.
body: Week 12 is still a rumor for six teams in this league. For Poochinski it’s a formality. This front office loaded eight starters into Thanksgiving, I wrote yesterday that it could wrap this up by dinner, and it did: 184.64 points before a single Sunday kickoff, 15.0 short of last week’s league-high 199.64 with three starters still to play.

The receipts: Jahmyr Gibbs 48.2. Javonte Williams 33.3 out of the FLEX. Dak Prescott 26.54 and Caleb Williams 25.3, which is what a two-quarterback league looks like when you have two quarterbacks. CeeDee Lamb 20.4, Sam LaPorta 14.4, Brandon Aubrey 9.0, Luther Burden III 7.5. Those eight projected for 143.77 combined. They didn’t read the projection.

deeboliciouskins didn’t play badly. It just played the wrong Thursday. D’Andre Swift put up 29.2, George Pickens 11.7, and the Kansas City Chiefs D/ST this column raised an eyebrow at yesterday scored 10.0, beating the Minnesota Vikings D/ST’s 8.8 projection on the bench. That call was right. Patrick Mahomes managed 7.16. Total: 58.06.

Now the math. deeboliciouskins trails by 126.58. Its seven remaining starters (Jayden Daniels, Jonathan Taylor, Ja’Marr Chase, Tyler Warren, Tony Pollard, Malik Nabers and Drew Stevens) project for 104.42. Poochinski still has Chase Brown, Chris Olave and San Francisco 49ers D/ST to come and a live projection of 221.85. Win probability: 97.9% to 2.1%.

There is no lineup drama to cover here. Poochinski’s lineup as set is its best lineup, 180.98 either way. The only open question is whether the 184.64 becomes the week’s high score, and nobody else projects higher than Cherry Blossom’s 167.43.

Stakes: Poochinski is 9-2 with a 54-23 all-play record. Bad things man bad things, the 8-3 team chasing it, is in a 50.3% coin flip with Santa Clara’s Finest. deeboliciouskins is 6-5 and its playoff odds are 100% either way, so this one costs it seeding, not a spot. Small comfort. Big number.

quick_hits.headline: AB81 benched 43.0. Now it has till noon.
quick_hits.body: DeVonta Smith scored 43.0 Thursday from AB81’s bench, the Smith move this column pitched yesterday for Derrick Henry’s slot. Henry is still Questionable with a concussion and still starting. AB81 is fine anyway, 79.4% against Big Stric, but the next call comes fast: Rico Dowdle (7.79, FLEX) and Germie Bernard (7.39, WR) both play at Fri 12:00 PM, while George Kittle (11.91) and Mike Evans (13.28, Questionable, Achilles) sit on the bench. As set, AB81 projects for 133.31. Set right, 151.45.

quick_hits.headline: Big Stric’s kicker was its best player
quick_hits.body: Big Stric made its call at running back yesterday: Saquon Barkley in. Barkley scored 0.7. Josh Allen scored 5.54, Rashee Rice 3.9, Dalton Kincaid 3.3, and Tyler Bass led the Thursday crew with 11.0. Five starters projected for 61.43 produced 24.44. Big Stric still technically leads AB81 on the scoreboard, but the win probability is 20.6%, and Geno Smith, Nico Collins and Justin Jefferson have Sunday to change that.

quick_hits.headline: One playoff spot. Three teams. 100%.
quick_hits.body: Five teams are at 100% playoff odds. The last spot belongs to one of three: Maye I touch your TDs? at 70.8%, Santa Clara’s Finest at 25.7%, Big Stric Energy at 3.5%. Add them up and you get exactly one ticket. This weekend: Maye is 45.1% against Cherry Blossom, the Finest 49.7% against Bad things, Big Stric 20.6% against AB81.

quick_hits.headline: What will the champ do at quarterback?
quick_hits.body: Brock Purdy (15.99) is Questionable with an ankle and Maye I touch your TDs? has no quarterback on the bench. Deshaun Watson projects for 16.3, is unrostered, and plays at Sun 5:20 PM, after Purdy’s Sun 1:25 PM kickoff. That’s a free insurance policy: start Purdy, keep Watson ready. Zay Flowers shed his tag, so that FLEX call answered itself. Maye leads Cherry Blossom 57.7 to 50.92 on the board.

quick_hits.headline: The Finest have no backup at RB or TE
quick_hits.body: Bhayshul Tuten (15.18, undisclosed) and Isaiah Likely (14.52, groin) are both Questionable, both play Sun 10:00 AM, and the bench has no running back or tight end to replace either. Chris Rodriguez Jr. (9.2) is the wire answer at RB. Rome Odunze gave the Finest 26.7 Thursday; Colston Loveland gave them -0.5 from the FLEX and is now listed Out with a knee. Coin flip: 49.7%.

quick_hits.headline: Bad things has to bet on McMillan early
quick_hits.body: Tetairoa McMillan (14.24) is Questionable with a foot and doesn’t play until Mon 5:15 PM. The fallbacks lock first: Jordyn Tyson (11.67) at Sun 10:00 AM, Antonio Williams (9.8) at Sun 1:25 PM. In a 50.3% matchup, that’s a real bet. Bad things leads the Finest 36.4 to 26.2 already.

w12-m1.headline: AB81 survives its own bench
w12-m1.blurb: Big Stric 24.44, AB81 21.1, and the odds say AB81 79.4%. AB81 has nine starters left projecting for 104.31; Big Stric has six projecting for 85.18. AB81’s best lineup (151.45) needs moves at noon Friday and on Sunday.

w12-m2.headline: Cherry Blossom gets two looks today
w12-m2.blurb: Maye leads 57.7 to 50.92, but Cherry Blossom projects 167.43 to 163.18, 54.9%. Jonah Coleman (17.71) and Jaylen Warren (12.81) play at noon today. Maye plays nobody until Sunday and needs Purdy healthy.

w12-m3.headline: Poochinski already won. Probably.
w12-m3.blurb: 184.64 to 58.06. deeboliciouskins needs 126.58 from seven starters projected for 104.42. 97.9% Poochinski.

w12-m4.headline: The only true coin flip left
w12-m4.blurb: Bad things 159.03, the Finest 158.76: 50.3% to 49.7%. Bad things has the 36.4 to 26.2 lead and a Monday McMillan question; the Finest have nine starters left, two Questionable with no cover. I’ll take the team with backups.

w12-r8-s8.headline: AB81 at FLEX: Kittle, by noon
w12-r8-s8.blurb: Rico Dowdle (7.79) plays at Fri 12:00 PM, so this one can’t wait for Sunday. George Kittle (11.91) is healthy and projects 4 more. Make the move before kickoff.

w12-r8-s5.headline: AB81 at WR: Bernard or Evans?
w12-r8-s5.blurb: Germie Bernard (7.39) also locks at Fri 12:00 PM. Mike Evans (13.28) projects higher but is Questionable with an Achilles. Swap in Evans and you’re betting on Sunday news; keep Bernard and you’re locking in the floor.

w12-r8-s0.headline: AB81 at QB: Darnold over Herbert
w12-r8-s0.blurb: Justin Herbert (13.16) is Questionable with a concussion; Sam Darnold (15.2) has no tag and projects higher. Herbert kicks off Sun 1:05 PM, before Darnold’s Sun 1:25 PM. I’d start Darnold.

w12-r8-s2.headline: AB81 at RB: Henry, take two
w12-r8-s2.blurb: Henry (13.87) is still Questionable with a concussion and plays Sun 10:00 AM. The Smith escape hatch closed Thursday. Kittle can cover via a flex shuffle, but if Kittle goes in for Dowdle today, Evans is the cover, and he’s Questionable too.

w12-r8-s4.headline: AB81 at WR: JSN has no understudy
w12-r8-s4.blurb: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (23.75) is Questionable with an ankle and there’s no healthy receiver behind him. He plays Sun 1:25 PM. Ride him, and watch the wire.

w12-r3-s0.headline: Maye at QB: Purdy, with Watson in the pocket
w12-r3-s0.blurb: Purdy (15.99) is Questionable; no bench QB. Deshaun Watson (16.3) plays later on Sunday, so adding him now buys a pivot if Purdy is ruled out.

w12-r4-s5.headline: Cherry Blossom at WR: Washington or Tucker?
w12-r4-s5.blurb: Parker Washington (16.89) is Questionable with a shoulder and kicks off Sun 10:00 AM. Tre Tucker (7.8) is healthy and plays Sun 5:20 PM. The call is really due at Washington’s kickoff. I’d play Washington.

w12-r5-s4.headline: Bad things at WR: McMillan, Tyson or Williams?
w12-r5-s4.blurb: McMillan (14.24) plays Monday night, Questionable. Tyson (11.67) locks Sun 10:00 AM, Antonio Williams (9.8) Sun 1:25 PM. If McMillan is still a question by Sunday afternoon, Williams is the last exit.

w12-r7-s3.headline: The Finest at RB: Tuten or Rodriguez
w12-r7-s3.blurb: Tuten (15.18) is Questionable, undisclosed, and the bench has no running back. Chris Rodriguez Jr. (9.2), his teammate, is unrostered. Same kickoff, Sun 10:00 AM.

w12-r7-s6.headline: The Finest at TE: Likely or nothing
w12-r7-s6.blurb: Isaiah Likely (14.52) is Questionable with a groin. No tight end on the bench, and the FLEX that held Loveland already played.

w12-r1-s2.headline: Big Stric at RB: Barkley in, 0.7 out
w12-r1-s2.blurb: The call was right on paper: Barkley (15.63) over Braelon Allen. Barkley scored 0.7. Allen, now in the FLEX, still plays Sunday.
